title: Sparse-Probe Roundness Adjudication
dataset: Generated corpus (generate.py + flat raw_upload.zip). Generator calibrated against Zenodo record 7004548, 'Roundness Measurement Dataset' (Aalto University), Talyrond TR31c traces of 5 roundness reference workpieces, 3600 pts/rev, ISO 12181-2 Gaussian 15 UPR filter.

notes: Candidate #4 of slot batch-20260920-044727-task-002. Candidates 1-3 rejected on measured evidence; those verdicts stand.
Scored heads: calibrated p10/p50/p90 of the true filtered roundness RONt (um); probability the characteristic conforms to the drawing tolerance; the latent machine/set-up signature class (6-way).

Answers the batch-wide universal-signal rule structurally: the released corpus is generated under a private seed and has no public counterpart, so source access confers nothing. The learnable structure is physical - the undulations-per-revolution spectrum of machined surfaces and the folding of harmonic k onto k mod n under n-point probing - and is taught entirely by the released training split.

Design v3 fixes measured in this session: (a) plain pinball let a copied-input submission reach 0.404, so the quantile head is now a proper interval score; (b) the drawing tolerance was a metadata shortcut to conformance (0.323), so it is now tied to the machine's process capability (0.026); (c) the ABC ceiling collapsed to ESS 2.3 of 12000 draws, so the harmonic coefficients are now circular Gaussian and the ceiling is an exact latent-oracle conditional.
